_meta.purpose: Single source of truth for the Rewards Finder, homepage comparison table and volume bracket pages. All are generated from this file at build time.
_meta.sourcing_policy: On-site facts used where they exist. Fields the site does not publish (VIP tier thresholds, some rakeback rates, payout model type, per-casino test dates) are MODELED ESTIMATES, each marked assumed:true and listed in flags. Nothing estimated is presented as measured.
_meta.test_date_note: withdrawal_test.date is the last data-verification date (2026-07-09), not a fresh per-transaction test. Labeled honestly on the methodology page.
flags: TIER THRESHOLDS are not published on-site for any casino. All monthly_wager_threshold values are modeled estimates.
PAYOUT MODEL TYPE is not stated on-site; inferred from how each program is described publicly.
TEST DATES: the site stores withdrawal speed, not dated tests. Stamps use the 2026-07-09 data-verification date, labeled as such.
CONFLICT - BC.Game rakeback: homepage says 20-24%, review says starts at 0.5%. Modeled as tiered 6-20% and flagged.
Only Stake, BC.Game, Thrill, XTP and mBit have any on-site rakeback figure. Roobet, Shuffle, Duelbits rates are modeled.
